title: Verifying 17 Million Lines of Lean
title_zh: 如何验证一千七百万行黎曼猜想证明
summary: 175,187 Lean files and 17,374,215 lines with no comments: no referee can read them, so do not trust them, replay them. The 27-line Challenge.lean fixes the five statements against official Mathlib v4.33.1; ci/plan.py cuts Main into 8,490 SHA-256 content-addressed shards that public CI publishes to open Releases; four commands and leanchecker --fresh let anyone replay them in an empty kernel and audit the axioms; and a six-checker route judges an exported copy offline (rehearsed; the full run is still in progress).
summary_zh: 175,187 个 Lean 文件、17,374,215 行、没有一行注释：没有审稿人读得完，所以别信它，重放它。27 行的 Challenge.lean 以官方 Mathlib v4.33.1 锁定五条陈述；ci/plan.py 把 Main 切成 8,490 块以 SHA-256 内容寻址的分片，由公开 CI 发布到公开 Release；四行命令加上 leanchecker --fresh，让任何人都能在空白内核里重放并审计公理；六个检查器的离线评审路线则审查导出的副本（已完成演练，完整运行仍在进行中）。
subject: https://github.com/the-omega-institute/riemann-hypothesis
style: trureturing cyberpunk · one pixel per file, the 27-line challenge, 8,490 content-addressed shards, four commands, an empty kernel and six checkers
